title: consolida regalis var. sparsiflora
intro: Consolida regalis var. sparsiflora, commonly known as  Larkspur, is a perennial plant in the borage family that is known for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The health benefits of Consolida regalis var. sparsiflora include its potential to lower blood pressure and act as an antispasmodic, helping to reduce muscle spasms and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a nervine, sedative, and anodyne, providing relief from pain and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Consolida regalis var. sparsiflora include alkaloids such as delphinine, ajacine, and ajaculin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
